{{Quote|We can't do much about the ChaseX squadron, but we'll give the cruiser and her escorts something to worry about.|[[Taryn Zel]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
'''''Lady Worbi''''' was a [[Stella-class frigate|''Stella''-class frigate]] of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]]. Sometime in [[44 ABY]], ''Lady Worbi'' traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the command of [[Taryn Zel]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zekk]], in pursuit of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to recover [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], the [[Chume'da]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Zel attempted to arrange a transfer for Allana, but the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]] task force patrolling Coruscant space already deployed [[XJ5 X-wing starfighter|XJ5 ChaseX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to pursue the ''Falcon''. In response, Zel deployed ''Lady Worbi's'' three [[Miy'til starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to distract the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] task force.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse" />
